verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents basic transfer paths: the CLI walkthrough includes a "copy data" step, SSH docs cite secure file transfer, and persistent volumes can be reattached to new instances. There is no evidence of S3-compatible endpoints or cloud-storage sync, and community reports of poor, inconsistent host bandwidth undercut the "efficiently" part. Missing for 10: S3-compatible endpoints, cloud-storage sync integration, in-depth transfer tooling docs, and evidence of consistent transfer throughput.
